mapper.insert: insert into batch.trigger_launch_recovery (tenant_id, request_id, envelope_ciphertext, trace_id, next_attempt_at) values (#{tenantId}, #{requestId}, #{envelopeCiphertext}, #{traceId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) on conflict (tenant_id, request_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select tenant_id as tenantId, request_id as requestId, envelope_ciphertext as envelopeCiphertext, trace_id as traceId, attempts, recovery_generation as recoveryGeneration, recovery_status as recoveryStatus, last_error_code as lastErrorCode from batch.trigger_launch_recovery where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} for update
mapper.update: update batch.trigger_launch_recovery set recovery_status = #{nextStatus}, attempts = 0, recovery_generation = recovery_generation + 1, next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and recovery_status = 'DEAD'
mapper.select: select tenant_id as tenantId, request_id as requestId, envelope_ciphertext as envelopeCiphertext, trace_id as traceId, attempts as attempts, recovery_generation as recoveryGeneration, recovery_status as recoveryStatus, last_error_code as lastErrorCode from batch.trigger_launch_recovery where recovery_status = 'PENDING' and next_attempt_at <= #{now} order by next_attempt_at asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update batch.trigger_launch_recovery set attempts = attempts + 1, recovery_status = #{status}, next_attempt_at = coalesce(#{nextAttemptAt}, next_attempt_at), last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and recovery_generation = #{recoveryGeneration} and recovery_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: update batch.trigger_launch_recovery set attempts = attempts + 1, recovery_status = case when attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} then 'DEAD' else 'PENDING' end, next_attempt_at = case when attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} then next_attempt_at else #{now}::timestamptz + make_interval(secs => least(#{maxBackoffSeconds}::numeric, greatest(1::numeric, #{baseBackoffSeconds}::numeric * power(2::numeric, least(greatest(attempts, 0), 10))))::double precision) end, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and recovery_generation = #{recoveryGeneration} and recovery_status = 'PENDING' returning recovery_status
